method: Conditional-logit regression over candidate points on major OSM roads. Layer 1 street network, layer 2 OSM-derived traffic-exposure proxy (no measured traffic), layer 3 crash-type compatibility, layer 4 independent coordinate sources (OSM geocoders, GeoNames, Wikidata, 2023 report placements) with data-estimated spreads. The best layer set is chosen by leave-one-source-out validation.

validation.method: Leave-one-source-out: one independent coordinate source is hidden, the position is estimated from the stored point, the layers and the remaining sources, and the distance to the hidden source is measured. Weights are re-fitted without the zone when it is a training anchor.
validation.caveat: The hidden sources are coordinates of the NAMED PLACE (geocoders, gazetteers, the 2023 placements), not true crash positions, and the OSM-based sources are not fully independent of the OSM road layer. This shows which layers help recover the named place, not where crashes occurred.
